mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% for three consecutive months predicts a tightening of monetary policy, which reduces the present value of future earnings and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: rising inflation in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window following the trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-inflation spike period (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly PAYEMS labor cost growth above 1.5% coincides with elevated wage growth expectations that compress real business profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor cost acceleration in a growth cycle
failure_condition: At least 40% of triggered months show SPX 20d returns ≥ 0, contradicting the predicted negative skew (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly GDPC1 personal consumption expenditure grows faster than GDP deflator (GDPC1/GDPC1_GDPC1 < 1), it indicates stronger real demand, which elevates equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > GDP deflator growth rate
failure_condition: In 80% of such triggered windows, 20d forward returns are ≤ 0 (binomial proportion test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO supply index falling below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing capacity, which raises uncertainty and lowers S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: More than 60% of INDPRO < 100 events result in SPX 20d returns ≥ 0 (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly FEDFUNDS rates for two consecutive months creates a forward discounting effect that increases the present value of equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 50% of such windows, 20d forward returns remain negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly UNRATE falls below 3%, it reflects labor market slack that reduces wage growth expectations and supports negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: More than 70% of such events show SPX 20d returns ≥ 0 (p < 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS retail sales exceeding 1% growth above prior month's level indicate accelerating consumer demand, which elevates equity risk premia and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 75% of triggered windows, 20d forward returns are positive (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in monthly HOUST housing starts below 1,500 units signals a supply glut that lowers price growth expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 50% of triggered windows, 20d forward returns are negative (p < 0.10).
